newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine millers plan to buy 40,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine millers plan to buy 40,000 T wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers are seeking suppliers to buy 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for February 27 to March 24 delivery, traders involved in the deal told Reuters on Thursday.

The traders say the firms want to buy around 16,400 tonnes of western white wheat, 11,700 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a protein content of 13.5 percent, and 11,900 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a protein content of 14 percent.
Other details of the order were not immediately available.
